name: Proofreading
description: Proofreads text for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and typographical errors, producing marked-up output with corrections and explanations. Final-pass error detection before publication. Use when the user asks to proofread a document, check for typos, fix grammar errors, or do a final error check on written text. Do NOT use for structural editing (use structural-editing), content revision (use copy-editing), tone changes (use tone-adjustment), or improving readability (use readability-improvement).
